runtime_hint: What the agent runtime received from this profile.

runtime_runtime_writable_missing: No agent runtime this hub can configure.

models_fetch_empty: The provider answered, but listed no models.
notify_test_sent: Sent. Check this phone and your other devices.
devices_just_paired: Just paired. The device is in the list below.

runtime_gateway_reloaded_waiting_for_run: Applying the change — Hermes restarts by itself once the reply in progress ends.
